Reviewer: `/root/f3_authority_review`, existing Astra/max assignment. All commands used the primary repository cwd. Only this receipt and its companion input JSON are writable by this review.

## Closure ledger

| Finding / boundary | Disposition and concrete evidence |
| --- | --- |
| HT-01: native-group and original-byte transport | **Closed at declaration level.** HT15–94 defines the Record's third constructor/factory argument and sole tenth method, `native():?AuditHistoryNativeGroup`. Capture serializes the same actual group and passes that group/tag/payload; Reader.next alone decodes the original bounded payload and passes the actual returned group with unchanged bytes. The native projection is present iff the fixed scalar tag requires it, with matching enum tag. Exact source guards bind those same locals; a name-only allowlist is explicitly insufficient. |
| HT-01: complete literal readers | **Closed.** HT59–84 names nine semantic/comparison entries, including both outer replays and both fenced comparison owners. Record tag/bytes have12 callers each, native10; NativeGroup tag4/scalars13. ArtifactReplay remains an original-string consumer through WorkReplay/CheckpointReplay, with no Record getter or additional decoder permission. Encode has only two CaptureWriter sites; decode only Reader.next. |
| HT-02: pre-capsule transfer | **Closed.** HT131–144 distinguishes failed creation, borrowed writing/sealing, returned seal, failed RO commit, failed capsule validation and successful capsule return. CaptureWriter retains pre-seal file disposal; successful finish transfers it to the exact seal. Both creating CaptureWriters may close that seal after failed RO commit or failed capsule factory. Obsolete file/seal disposal locals are cleared only after the corresponding successful transfer. Writer gains no closer/destructor. |
| HT-02: acquisition/root/comparison failure | **Closed with the Root supplement below.** HT148–208 assigns the actual capture to its original lexical workflow fallback until consume/take returns endpoints. Endpoint assignment precedes the protected beginRoot. Eight checkpoint root-owner methods and four control Writer methods call the new ninth `discardAfterFailure()` on unsuccessful exit, including beginRoot, comparison, close, later frame/write and commit failure. Failed consume/permit take before endpoint return uses the same actual capsule fallback; no extra PhaseAuthority getter is invented. |
| HT-02: failed cleanup and phase7 | **Closed.** HT109–127/159–161/204–208 makes failure terminal before cleanup/data access, clears unusable actual facts, and distinguishes capsule/seal open, attempt-started, checked-closed and failed state. Repeated outer fallback cannot call a lower closer twice or turn failed cleanup into success. Original sanitized failure and the common graph/abort boundary remain; an enclosing finally still disposes when abort cannot complete. Phase7's already-closed final comparison uses bounded retained facts, with no Reader/reopen/extra file close. |
| Reader/preload authority promotion | **Green for the exact text candidate.** It faithfully promotes the reviewed four shared collaborators per outer Replay, four local Reader sites, same ArtifactReplay identity, same-capture successful-origin comparison loan and native ownership retained by capsule/seal. Its16 literal additions exactly match type-closure183–198 in order. The two initialize callers, InstallationComposition return, nonempty Normalizer warmup and three data-only ArtifactReplay/F1 sites stay unchanged. |

The transport retains all31 scalar tags,13 byte tags, five empty tags and the fixed48-byte trailer, together with the original caps and49+1 total tag vocabulary. No byte reconstruction, digest-only native equality, current-authority substitute, public handle, extra parser/helper or namespace allowance is admitted.

## HT-02R-01 found and closed during this review

The frozen HT amendment190/201/226 and its JSON still included `AuditControlPublicationWorkflow::rootRevision` as a capsule-close fallback and counted the ordinary workflow as10 methods. The higher-precedence, already reviewed installer65c2e485 line153 had explicitly removed that ordinary method and fixed its count at9. Keeping the stale row would leave contradictory exact caller/owner instructions for implementation.

Root's authorized supplement527e1d13 resolves only this discrepancy. Both corrected ordered lists are exactly the old lists minus that single ordinary caller. The final control fallback count is **7**, CapturedControlHistory.close has **12** external callers, and ordinary PublicationWorkflow has **9** declarations. InstallationPublicationWorkflow::rootRevision and PublicationWriter::rootRevision remain. No new policy-selection or scheduler producer is restored. The original frozen HT artifact was not edited.

After applying that explicit precedence, the lower-close/discard counts are PrivateHistoryFile5, SealedHistory4, CapturedCheckpointHistory13, CapturedControlHistory12, checkpoint Endpoint discard8 and control Endpoint discard4. Counts describe fixed proposed source edges, not executed close operations.

## Retained finite budgets and proof requirements

Record is10 methods/max3 arguments; NativeGroup9/max2; Reader10/max2; SealedHistory10/max4; each capsule10/max3; each outer Endpoint9/max3. All existing representation controls remain. The new Endpoint failed state is an unsuccessful terminal state, not replay proof or a grant. Comparison still requires successful guarded Replay origin, exact original scope/capture/endpoint identity, full original bytes and the separately owned root generation.

The actual phase split remains prepareActual5/prepare6, complete7, persistActual8/persist9. The original workflow keeps only a reference to the same final capsule; it gains no native descriptor alias. Success must have completed checked closure before clearing a fallback, returning a phase result, signing, invoking F2 or starting a distinct next capture. Inspection and external Publisher completion retain their own explicit checked close after floor completion. No SQL runs under the floor; no cleanup emits successful phase/permission evidence.

The supplied39 affected source paths and14 test paths are unique and are all contained in the fixed literal allowlist61a77573/ebbfe5f9:295 edit paths,62 references,35 new and26 existing tests. This is bounded path membership, not a new whole-packet audit. No new file/type/test or directory grant is introduced.

HT239–253 retains concrete future proof for same-local native/original-byte transport, forbidden caller/mismatched projection, complete EOF and malformed records, successful seal followed by failed RO commit, failed factory transfer, pre-root/consume/permit failure, actual native mismatch, checked-close failure, preserved original failure, shared graph poisoning and zero seed/sign/F2 access after rejection. It also requires detecting skipped/double lower close and zero additional phase7 reopen/file calls. Native process-kill cases do not pretend PHP cleanup ran. The supported consuming-close premise and previously disclosed masked-close limitations are unchanged. None of these tests ran here.

## Exact promotion and input stability

All three promotion hunks were applied and checked **in memory only**, including exact original context. Both calculated candidate hashes match the manifest:

| Authority file | Current bytes | Exact candidate bytes |

| spec130 | `044639432fd345d0bd023825d5183c7b0735b26a27a437ecae325d183048997e` | `c028a81608c0a20f6eb2b3e2919c2562f4fe50870372ade2047a0c9d8b3b8a02` |
| D179 | `d051046774398dad0e18bcfa971bfd756e2b55a856bf7ad71c97929f56406fef` | `a50834a5cb3c1da927b2fc09d04bd6016d5a2410412661cb42807ba85412f72b` |

The final selected-input comparison at **2026-10-14T01:14:24.337079+00:00** covers **33 inputs:31 unchanged**. The two changes are the P/C copies of the same F5 Task: Root appended exactly483 bytes authorizing the finite cleanup supplement; each original35906-byte prefix remains byte-identical. The companion records before/after hashes and the exact append. Every substantive candidate, prior review, authority file and reused map stayed unchanged.

Only read-only text/JSON selections, SHA-256 comparisons, finite list/membership checks and in-memory diff application ran. An oversized diagnostic print and a dictionary-row bookkeeping check were narrowed/corrected without any file change; neither was a Product command or qualification result. No Product/test/governance/STATE/Git/PHP/Node/DB/Docker/native/network action or subagent occurred. Only the two named r3 review outputs are written.
